The factory output risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the judge_reward was lower at 0.20, the core logic met all functional requirements across the single trial. Future iterations should re-check the alignment between the verifier's success criteria and the judge's qualitative scoring to ensure full compliance.
